sources.observation: Public profile snapshot identifies Simon Willison and lists Datasette, sqlite-utils, LLM and other repositories under the account.
Datasette is a long-lived open-source tool for exploring and publishing data, with website/API, plugins and publishing workflows.
LLM is a CLI and Python library for interacting with multiple model providers, with logging, embeddings, schemas, tools, attachments and plugins; project news spans 2023-2026.
sqlite-utils is a Python CLI/library for manipulating SQLite, including import/query, FTS, transforms, migrations and plugins.
Recent August 2026 history includes 4.2/4.2.1 release work and maintainer commits for smoke tests, transforms, constraints, strict tables, indexes and introspection.
Repository is owned by simonw and has thousands of commits plus an active public release/issue ecosystem.
Repository is owned by simonw and exposes a broad plugin-oriented LLM CLI/library surface.
Repository is owned by simonw and remains actively maintained in August 2026.

scope_boundaries: Project ownership and sustained maintainer history support project-level authorship/maintainership, not sole authorship of every line.
SQLite application tooling does not imply SQLite engine internals mastery.
LLM product/tooling work does not imply model-training or model-research capability.
Provider/plugin breadth does not imply mastery of every dependency or provider.
